title: Land the credential-scout and GPU-probe draft of 2026-10-29
goal: The second workflow subagent worktree of the 2026-10-29 session held uncommitted work that never landed: the credential scout keeps a per-host interval record (credential_scout.last.json, one digest of host, vendors, endpoints and key fingerprints, scouted at most once per 300 s), the GPU VRAM total from nvidia-smi is memoized for the process (gpu_vram_gb) while the free query stays live, model lifecycle gains file verdicts (lifecycle/file_verdicts.rs) and selection reads them, susi-config gains extension and JSON helpers, and the external agent catalog grows. Rebased by three-way apply onto main of 2026-10-31; the one conflict (Windows available memory) keeps main's native Win32 probe, and the draft's PowerShell and kernel helpers it replaced are removed with their two tests. ARCHITECTURE.md describes the probes.
